newsitem.title: CHAD: Chad legislative election runoff set for Feb 23.
newsitem.headline: Chad legislative election runoff set for Feb 23.

text.p: President Idriss Deby confirmed February 23 as the date for the second round of Chad's legislative elections, a presidential decree said on Sunday.
Nomads in the Central African nation will vote over a three-day period from February 20,
The runoff was originally scheduled for February 23 but subject to Deby's confirmation.
A total of 68 seats of the 125-member assembly will be contested in the second round.
Final results from the January 5 first round released by the appeal court credited Deby's Patriotic Salvation Movement with 37 seats against a total of 20 for various other parties.

Deby, a former northern guerrilla leader, seized power in a 1990 French-backed coup. After repeated electoral delays, he won a multi-party presidential election in July in a runoff against southern rival and fellow general Wadal Abdelkader Kamougue.
